auditor_summary: Task 3 (F-30) deep-dive evidence: code trace establishing the shared mechanism boundary that separates the 5 failing bundle sub-tools (MSR, CGM, LEL, PANCHANG, DASHA) from the 3 succeeding ones (UCN, RM, CDLM).

dispatch_code.http_target: platform/src/app/api/mcp/bundles/[name]/route.ts (SSE bundle endpoint, same platform Next.js app)
dispatch_code.executor: platform/src/lib/mcp/bundle_adapters.ts:320-384 executeHolisticBundle() -- fans out Promise.allSettled over all 8 HOLISTIC_SUB_TOOLS via buildHolisticParams() (lines 274-303) + runSubTool()
dispatch_code.per_sub_tool_http_call: bundle_adapters.ts:131-151 callPrimitive(toolName, params, principal) -- fetch(`${PLATFORM_URL}/api/mcp/primitives/${toolName}`, ...) -- a SELF-REFERENTIAL HTTP loopback call from the platform app back to its own /api/mcp/primitives/[tool] route, made identically for all 8 sub-tools including the 3 that succeed
dispatch_code.gate_inside_primitives_route: platform/src/app/api/mcp/primitives/[tool]/route.ts:200-218 -- `if (isPerChartPrimitive(mcpToolName)) { ... const role = await resolveMcpPrincipalRole(userUid); const perm = await authorizeChartAccess(...); if (perm === 'deny') return 401 ... }` -- this gate runs ONLY for primitives whose resolved capability has scope:'per_chart'; vector_search (scope:'global') skips it entirely via the same `isPerChartPrimitive()` guard.

correlation_confirmed: The set {MSR, CGM, LEL, PANCHANG, DASHA} maps 1:1 onto the set of per_chart-scope capabilities reachable through this dispatch path; the set {UCN, RM, CDLM} maps 1:1 onto the one global-scope capability (query_classical_texts/vector_search). This split is deterministic and 100% reproducible across both charts and repeated calls -- never a random subset.

error_swallowing_confirmed.consequence: the real HTTP status code (400 CHART_REQUIRED? 401 entitlement denial? 500 uncaught exception?) IS captured in this Error message as a bare number, but runSubTool's catch block only reads err.name (for TimeoutError classification) and discards err.message entirely when building the served BundleEntryError -- the served envelope's `sub_errors: [{subsystem, error: 'sub-tool errored (tool_error)'}]` carries no trace of the actual status code.
